Claude Nuridsany and Marie Pérennou present their subjects without voiceover narration or educational framing, treating insect behaviour as pure dramatic spectacle — a rainstorm, a mating, a battle — set to Bruno Coulais's extraordinary musical score. Joe Berlinger and Bruce Sinofsky were given nearly unprecedented access to the investigation, trial, and families, and the resulting documentary raises serious and ultimately vindicated doubts about the guilt of the convicted teenagers.
